protocol: Mean and standard error over 23 held-out compositions; the framework runs independently on 100 query images per class; FID, CLIP image-image cosine, and Inception-V3 k-NN precision and recall with k=3; Faithfulness reference is the 100 queries and Generalization reference is 100 other held-out images; DDIM eta 0 with 50 steps; seed 42; 16 saved generations per query per teacher; FID at N=100 is biased upward and is not comparable with N=50,000 FIDs.
